newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA SHELL BLAST KILLS ONE, ANOTHER FEARED DEAD.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA SHELL BLAST KILLS ONE, ANOTHER FEARED DEAD.

text.p: A Romanian marine died and another one was reported missing after a shell exploaded on board a minesweeper near the Black Sea port of Constanta, a military official said on Monday.

An official at the army's General Staff told Reuters the incident occured during a drill earlier in the day when a shell loaded into an anti-aircraft gun misfired and exploded on the minesweeper's deck.

There was no immediate explanation for the blast, which killed the gunner and threw other three marines over the board. One was reported missing and feared dead, but the other two remained unharmed, the official said.
Earlier this month, 16 people died when an experimental bomb exploded on a military airfield in southern Romania.
Constanta port authorities said activity in the port had not been affected by the blast.
A Defence Ministry commission was investigating the case, the army official said. REUTER
